ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels covering approximately 90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized in scars and at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation across the macro-structure; discrete high-contrast white circular spots (blobs) are scattered across the interior lobes, with a higher concentration of white mottling localized near the inferior central notch and along the jagged distal margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression at the center-point with a wide, obtuse interior angle; depth is low relative to the vertical pixel height of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys localized at the distal tips; the medial trailing edge shows low-amplitude, undulating variations with several distinct V-shaped micro-notches.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch, sweeping upward and outward to form an asymmetrical fan-like profile terminating at jagged tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the ventral plane, notably three distinct clusters on the medial left lobe and several smaller clusters near the central notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (light-colored scratches) visible on both lobes; a prominent set of roughly parallel diagonal lines is detected on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular topography and possible barnacle encrustation on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; extensive white scarring (rake marks) distributed across the dark pigment field.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged, cauliflower-like texture at the fluke tips, diverging from a smooth geometric curve.
